We don't do generic. Every client group has different pressures, deadlines and opportunities — our advice reflects that.
SMEs
Annual accounts, bookkeeping, payroll and cash flow forecasting for growing businesses, plus a named accountant who actually answers the phone.
Contractors
IR35 assessments, limited company set-up, dividend planning and take-home pay optimisation for contractors and freelancers.

Who we help

sections.label: Everything you need under one roof
text: Everything you need under one roof
From day-to-day bookkeeping to complex tax planning, we cover the full spectrum of accountancy so you never need three different advisers.
Annual Accounts & Corporation Tax
Statutory accounts prepared and filed with Companies House and HMRC, with corporation tax computations and clear explanations of what's owed and when.
Bookkeeping & VAT
Cloud bookkeeping in Xero or QuickBooks, MTD-compliant VAT returns, and monthly management information so you always know where you stand.
Payroll & Auto-Enrolment
Weekly or monthly payroll runs, payslips, P60s and P45s, and pension auto-enrolment administration handled end to end.
Self Assessment Tax Returns
Personal tax returns prepared, checked and filed, with proactive advice on reducing your liability well before the 31 January deadline.
IR35 & Contractor Structuring
Status assessments, limited company vs umbrella advice, and dividend/salary planning to keep more of what you earn, compliantly.
Property & Landlord Tax
Rental income accounts, mortgage interest relief planning, incorporation reviews and advice on Stamp Duty and Capital Gains Tax.
Tax Planning & Advisory
Proactive, forward-looking planning around pensions, dividends, capital gains, inheritance tax and business structure — not just compliance.
Company Formation & Structuring
Limited company incorporation, shareholder agreements, and guidance on the right structure for tax efficiency and future growth.
HMRC Enquiries & Investigations
Representation and correspondence handled on your behalf if HMRC opens an enquiry, with fee protection insurance available.

sections.label: Common questions
text: Common questions
How much does it cost to switch accountants?

There's no cost to switch. We handle the professional clearance process with your existing accountant and can usually have your records transferred within a week, with no gap in your compliance cover.
Do you work with clients outside Manchester?
Yes — the majority of our clients are supported remotely by phone, video call and our client portal. We work with SMEs, contractors and landlords across the whole of the UK.
Can you help if I've received an HMRC enquiry letter?

Yes. We regularly represent clients in HMRC enquiries and can correspond with HMRC directly on your behalf. If you're not yet a client, get in touch as soon as possible — response deadlines are often tight.
What software do I need to use?
We're partnered with Xero and QuickBooks and recommend both for real-time bookkeeping. If you use a different system or spreadsheets, we can usually still work with what you have.
Do you offer fee protection insurance?
Yes, we offer optional fee protection insurance that covers the cost of our time if HMRC opens an enquiry into your affairs, so an investigation doesn't come with an unexpected bill.
